comment: Display layouts and the recorded system baseline that preflight PF-11 requires before a GUI run. NSScreen coordinates: origin at the bottom-left of the main display, y grows upwards. menuExtras pins the menu-bar item owners (window counts in the menu-bar strip, owner names only): a run refuses while any extra beyond this recorded configuration is present, so no name-bearing or third-party menu extra can enter a captured menu bar.

abc.comment: Spec-dock layout on BetterDisplay virtual displays: A 2x (main), B to the right at 1x, C left-below at 1x.
